title: TRAC: Trajectory-aware Reuse and Adaptive Correction for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
title_zh: TRAC：面向高效自回归视频生成的轨迹感知复用与自适应修正

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive (AR) video generation enables scalable long-video synthesis by sequentially generating fixed-length chunks, but incurs substantial computational cost from repeated denoising and attention over growing historical contexts. Recent cache reuse methods exploit temporal redundancy to reduce this cost, yet are mainly designed for single-trajectory generation, making them less suitable for sequentially coupled AR trajectories where approximation errors can accumulate and propagate across chunks. To address this challenge, we propose TRAC , a T rajectory-aware R euse and A daptive C orrection framework for efficient and robust AR video generation. TRAC integrates three complementary components: (1) Robust Cumulative Scheduling (RCS) , which selects cache reuse schedules by accounting for cumulative rollout errors and their variation across chunks and prompts; (2) Autoregressive Trajectory-aware Guidance Scheduling (ATGS) , which coordinates classifier-free guidance refreshes along the global AR trajectory; and (3) Spectral Structure Correction (SSC) , which adaptively restores low-frequency structural information to mitigate long-term error accumulation. By combining these innovations, TRAC substantially improves the efficiency-quality trade-off of AR video generation. For example, on VBench with SkyReels-V2, it achieves a 6.03 × 6.03\times speedup over the vanilla model with only ∼ 0.6 % \sim 0.6\% VBench score degradation, while consistently outperforming existing AR acceleration methods in both latency and generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归（AR）视频生成通过依次生成固定长度的片段，实现了可扩展的长视频合成，但由于需要重复进行去噪操作以及对不断扩展的历史上下文执行注意力机制，因此会产生巨大的计算成本。 近期的缓存重用方法利用时间冗余来降低这一成本，但主要针对单轨迹生成而设计，因此对于存在序列耦合的自回归轨迹并不适用——在这些轨迹中，近似误差可能会在片段之间累积并传播。 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 TRAC，即一种面向轨迹的缓存重用与自适应校正框架（T rajectory-aware R euse and A daptive C orrection framework），旨在实现高效且稳健的自回归视频生成。 TRAC 整合了三个互补的组件：（1）稳健累积调度（RCS），通过考虑累积展开误差及其在不同片段和提示中的变化来选择缓存重用方案；（2）自回归轨迹感知引导调度（ATGS），用于在全球自回归轨迹上协调无分类器引导的更新；以及（3）频谱结构校正（SSC），能够自适应地恢复低频结构信息，以缓解长期误差累积问题。 通过结合这些创新，TRAC 显著改善了自回归视频生成在效率与质量之间的权衡。 例如，在配备 SkyReels-V2 的 VBench 测试中，与基础模型相比，TRAC 实现了 6.03 × 6.03\times 的速度提升，而 VBench 得分仅下降约 ∼ 0.6 % \sim 0.6\%，同时在延迟和生成质量方面均持续优于现有的自回归加速方法。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive (AR) video generation has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for synthesizing long videos ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . Instead of denoising an entire video jointly, AR video models divide a long video into fixed-length chunks and generate them sequentially. For each chunk, the model performs a denoising process conditioned on the previously generated chunks, which are retained as historical context, making long-video generation substantially more scalable ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Teng et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2024a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 自回归（AR）视频生成最近已成为一种有前景的范式，可用于合成长视频（Yin 等，2025；Huang 等，2026）。 AR 视频模型不会对整个视频进行联合去噪，而是将长视频划分为固定长度的片段，并依次生成这些片段。 对于每个片段，模型会基于先前生成的片段（这些片段被保留为历史上下文）执行去噪过程，这使得长视频生成在可扩展性上有了显著提升（Chen 等，2025；Teng 等，2025；Gao 等，2024a）。

paragraphs.en: However, this scalability comes at a considerable computational cost ( Ma et al., 2026b ; Ji et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . As generation proceeds, each new chunk must repeatedly attend to the growing historical context and undergo a heavy denoising trajectory. Moreover, classifier-free guidance (CFG) requires both conditional and unconditional predictions at each guided denoising step ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ) , further increasing the inference cost. Consequently, long-video generation remains far from practical real-time deployment ( Teng et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这种可扩展性需要付出相当高的计算代价（Ma 等人，2026b；Ji 等人，2026；Lu 等人，2026）。 随着生成过程的推进，每个新的片段都必须反复关注不断扩展的历史上下文，并经历复杂的降噪过程。 此外，无分类器引导（CFG）在每个引导降噪步骤中都需要同时执行条件预测和无条件预测（Ho 和 Salimans，2022），这进一步增加了推理成本。 因此，长视频生成距离实用的实时部署仍有很大差距（Teng 等人，2025；Ma 等人，2026b）。

paragraphs.en: To reduce this cost, a growing body of work accelerates video generation by selectively executing the full model at a subset of denoising steps and reusing cached information at the remaining steps ( Guo et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Lv et al., 2026 ; Yi et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . Among them, training-free cache reuse-based acceleration methods are particularly attractive because they introduce no additional training or modification to the base generator ( Ma et al., 2024b ; Ma et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Kahatapitiya et al., 2025 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Xi et al., 2025 ; Castillo et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . For example, MeanCache ( Gao et al., 2026 ) approximates intermediate velocities using cached Jacobian-vector products (JVPs) and determines a cache schedule through offline calibration. CFG reuse methods ( Castillo et al., 2025 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) exploit the similarity between conditional and unconditional predictions by refreshing the guidance residual only at selected steps. These methods demonstrate that substantial redundancy exists throughout the generation process and can be effectively exploited for efficient inference.
paragraphs.zh: 为了降低这一成本，越来越多的研究通过仅在部分去噪步骤中执行完整模型，并在其余步骤中重用缓存信息，来加速视频生成（Guo et al., 2026；Ji et al., 2026；Shen et al., 2026；Lv et al., 2026；Yi et al., 2025；Lu et al., 2026；Ma et al., 2026b；Xu et al., 2026）。 其中，无需训练的基于缓存重用的加速方法尤其具有吸引力，因为它们不会对基础生成器引入任何额外的训练或修改（Ma et al., 2024b；Ma et al., 2024a；Liu et al., 2025；Zhao et al., 2025；Kahatapitiya et al., 2025；Lyu et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2026；Zhou et al., 2025；Xi et al., 2025；Castillo et al., 2025；Lee et al., 2026；Gao et al., 2026）。 例如，MeanCache（Gao et al., 2026）利用缓存的雅可比-向量积（JVPs）来近似中间速度，并通过离线校准确定缓存调度方案。 CFG重用方法（Castillo et al., 2025；Lyu et al., 2025；Lee et al., 2026）通过仅在选定的步骤中更新引导残差，利用条件预测与无条件预测之间的相似性。 这些方法表明，整个生成过程中存在大量冗余，并且可以高效地加以利用以实现高效的推理。

paragraphs.en: Despite this progress, directly applying existing cache reuse methods to AR video generation remains challenging. Most existing methods are developed for bidirectional video models, where the video is generated through a single denoising trajectory and reuse errors are primarily confined to that trajectory ( Ma et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, AR generation consists of sequentially connected chunk-level trajectories, where the approximation error in an earlier chunk can propagate through the autoregressive context and affect subsequent chunks. In this paper, considering this distinction, we identify three complementary challenges. First, cache scheduling should account for cumulative and cross-sample errors rather than local similarity alone. Existing schedulers such as MeanCache ( Gao et al., 2026 ) mainly evaluate local reuse errors, which may overlook their accumulation along the generation path and their variation across chunks and prompts. We therefore introduce robust cumulative scheduling (RCS), which selects cache schedules by jointly considering cumulative rollout error and cross-chunk/prompt risk. Second, CFG reuse should account for the sequential structure of the global AR trajectory. Existing CFG reuse methods ( Lyu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) are mainly designed for bidirectional models with a single denoising trajectory. In AR generation, however, multiple chunk-level trajectories are sequentially coupled through autoregressive context, making CFG reuse decisions dependent on the complete execution path. We therefore propose autoregressive trajectory-aware guidance scheduling (ATGS), which calibrates CFG refreshes over the global AR trajectory. Third, cache reuse can induce long-term low-frequency structural loss. Repeated approximation gradually accumulates errors in low-frequency components that encode global appearance and layout ( Li et al., 2026 ) . We therefore introduce spectral structure correction (SSC), which uses the first chunk as a stable structural reference and adaptively injects low-frequency information according to local motion, preserving global coherence while retaining dynamic details.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，但将现有的缓存重用方法直接应用于 AR 视频生成仍然充满挑战。 大多数现有方法都是为双向视频模型设计的，在这些模型中，视频通过单一的去噪轨迹生成，而重用错误主要局限于该轨迹（Ma et al., 2026b；Xu et al., 2026）。 相比之下，AR 生成由依次连接的片段级轨迹组成，其中早期片段中的近似误差可能通过自回归上下文传播，并影响后续片段。 在本文中，考虑到这种差异，我们识别出三个相互补充的挑战。 首先，缓存调度应同时考虑累积性和跨样本误差，而不仅仅是局部相似性。 现有的调度器（如 MeanCache（Gao et al., 2026））主要评估局部重用误差，但可能忽视了这些误差在生成路径上的累积效应，以及其在不同片段和提示之间的差异。 因此，我们提出了稳健的累积调度（RCS），该方法通过综合考虑累积展开误差和跨片段/提示风险来选择缓存调度方案。 其次，CFG 重用应考虑全局 AR 轨迹的序列结构。 现有的 CFG 重用方法（Lyu et al., 2025；Lee et al., 2026）主要是为具有单一去噪轨迹的双向模型设计的。 然而，在 AR 生成中，多个片段级轨迹通过自回归上下文依次耦合，这使得 CFG 重用决策依赖于完整的执行路径。 因此，我们提出了自回归轨迹感知引导调度（ATGS），该方法在全局 AR 轨迹上校准 CFG 的刷新操作。 第三，缓存重用可能导致长期的低频结构损失。 重复近似会逐渐累积编码全局外观和布局的低频成分中的误差（Li et al., 2026）。 因此，我们提出了谱结构校正（SSC），该方法使用第一个片段作为稳定的结构参考，并根据局部运动自适应地注入低频信息，从而在保留动态细节的同时维持全局连贯性。

sents.zh: 因此，我们提出了谱结构校正（SSC），该方法使用第一个片段作为稳定的结构参考，并根据局部运动自适应地注入低频信息，从而在保留动态细节的同时维持全局连贯性。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 1 , RCS, ATGS, and SSC form a complementary framework, termed trajectory-aware reuse and adaptive correction (TRAC), for efficient and robust AR video generation. By jointly reducing redundant computation and controlling error accumulation, TRAC substantially accelerates long-video generation while maintaining high visual fidelity and temporal consistency. On VBench with SkyReels-V2, TRAC achieves a 6.03 × 6.03\times speedup over the vanilla model with only ∼ 0.6 % \sim 0.6\% quality degradation (82.44 vs. 82.97). Compared to FlowCache-slow ( Ma et al., 2026b ) , TRAC delivers a 0.36 0.36 higher VBench score while providing substantially better throughput ( 6.03 × 6.03\times vs. 4.97 × 4.97\times ). Against MotionCache ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , TRAC improves the score by 0.64 0.64 while accelerating generation by nearly 29 % 29\% ( 6.03 × 6.03\times vs. 4.68 × 4.68\times ).

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive video generation has become a dominant paradigm for extending video duration via producing content sequentially in temporally ordered video chunks ( Villegas et al., 2022 ; Kondratyuk et al., 2023 ; Henschel et al., 2025 ; Weng et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2024b ) . Recent advances in long-video diffusion, including Diffusion Forcing, CausVid, Ca2-VDM, SkyReels-V2, MAGI-1, LongLive, Self Forcing, and FramePack, further underscore the viability of autoregressive and diffusion-forcing approaches for high-fidelity long-video synthesis ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2024a ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Teng et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . In these models, the generation process interleaves chunk-local denoising trajectories, where later steps rely on previously generated content as historical context. Effective acceleration techniques for such a setting must therefore address both local denoising dynamics and the cumulative error that propagates across consecutive chunks ( Guo et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Lv et al., 2026 ; Yi et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 自回归视频生成已成为延长视频时长的主流范式，其通过按时间顺序依次生成视频片段来扩展内容（Villegas 等，2022；Kondratyuk 等，2023；Henschel 等，2025；Weng 等，2024；Gao 等，2024b）。 长视频扩散模型的最新进展，包括 Diffusion Forcing、CausVid、Ca2-VDM、SkyReels-V2、MAGI-1、LongLive、Self Forcing 和 FramePack，进一步证明了自回归和扩散强迫方法在生成高保真长视频方面的可行性（Chen 等，2024；Yin 等，2025；Gao 等，2024a；Chen 等，2025；Teng 等，2025；Yang 等，2025；Huang 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026）。 在这些模型中，生成过程交替进行片段级的去噪轨迹，其中后续步骤依赖先前生成的内容作为历史上下文。 因此，针对此类场景的有效加速技术必须同时解决局部去噪动态以及跨连续片段累积传播的错误（Guo 等，2026；Ji 等，2026；Shen 等，2026；Lv 等，2026；Yi 等，2025；Luo 等，2026；Lu 等，2026；Ma 等，2026b；Xu 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Training‑free cache acceleration methods reduce inference cost by reusing slowly‑varying intermediate features across neighboring denoising steps ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ) . For example, DeepCache reuses U-Net features ( Ma et al., 2024b ) , Learning-to-Cache learns a timestep-dependent layer caching policy ( Ma et al., 2024a ) . TeaCache estimates model-output changes from timestep-embedding-modulated inputs ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . MeanCache constructs interval average velocities from cached JVPs, builds an offline trajectory map, and determines a fixed cache schedule via graph search ( Gao et al., 2026 ) . The recent FlowCache generalizes uniform timestep caching to chunk‑wise policies ( Ma et al., 2026b ) , with a specific focus on AR video models. Moreover, to alleviate the computational cost of Classifier‑free guidance ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ) , several approaches exploit temporal redundancy in the guidance residual to reduce this overhead ( Castillo et al., 2025 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 无需训练的缓存加速方法通过复用相邻去噪步骤中变化缓慢的中间特征，从而降低推理成本（Zhao 等人，2025；Lyu 等人，2025）。 例如，DeepCache 复用了 U-Net 的特征（Ma 等人，2024b），而 Learning-to-Cache 则学习了一种依赖时间步长的层缓存策略（Ma 等人，2024a）。 TeaCache 通过时间步嵌入调制后的输入来估计模型输出的变化（Liu 等人，2025）。 MeanCache 从缓存的 JVP 中构建区间平均速度，建立离线轨迹图，并通过图搜索确定固定的缓存调度方案（Gao 等人，2026）。 近期的 FlowCache 将均匀的时间步缓存推广到了分块策略（Ma 等人，2026b），并特别关注了 AR 视频模型。 此外，为了缓解无分类器引导（Classifier-free guidance）的计算成本（Ho 和 Salimans，2022），多种方法利用了引导残差中的时间冗余来降低这一开销（Castillo 等人，2025；Lyu 等人，2025；Lee 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Extensive methods have also been proposed to address temporal consistency and structural drift in long‑video generation. For instance, FreeNoise reschedules noise for extended video diffusion ( Qiu et al., 2024 ) . FreeInit refines initial noise to close the initialization gap ( Wu et al., 2024 ) . GLC‑Diffusion integrates global and local denoising to balance long‑range coherence and fine‑grained detail ( Ma et al., 2026a ) . Another thread tackles degradation from a frequency‑domain perspective. For instance, FreeLong ( Lu et al., 2024 ) extends video length by spectrally blending global and local temporal attention features, while FreeLong++ ( Lu and Yang, 2025 ) improves consistency across multiple frequency bands through a multi-band spectral fusion approach. Most relevant to our work, FreqForcing ( Li et al., 2026 ) attributes drift in autoregressive long‑video generation to low‑frequency spectral energy, and proposes Spectral Self‑Anchoring (SSA) to address it. SSA combines a local branch for motion/details, an anchor branch for low‑frequency structure from early frames, and frequency‑domain fusion.

paragraphs.en: Cache Reuse. Cache reuse ( Ma et al., 2024b ; Ma et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026b ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) accelerates inference by selectively executing full model forward passes at a subset of denoising steps and reusing cached information at the remaining steps. Specifically, a cache schedule 𝒮 = { s i } i = 0 L − 1 \mathcal{S}=\{s_{i}\}_{i=0}^{L-1} specifies the denoising steps where full model forward passes are executed. Two adjacent selected steps ( s i , s i + 1 ) (s_{i},s_{i+1}) define a reuse span, within which intermediate steps reuse cached information. Recently, MeanCache ( Gao et al., 2026 ) approximates intermediate velocities via cached Jacobian-vector products (JVPs), which are averaged over a subset of prompts to enable efficient video synthesis.

paragraphs.en: Despite its progress, MeanCache ( Gao et al., 2026 ) determines the cache schedule merely based on the average of local reuse errors over all chunks and prompts, while neglecting cross-chunks/prompts robustness and the cumulative impact of reuse errors along the trajectory. To address these issues, we propose robust cumulative scheduling (RCS), which formulates cache schedule selection as a risk-aware optimization problem that jointly accounts for cross-chunks/prompts robustness and cumulative rollout error.

paragraphs.en: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) introduces significant computational cost from repeated residual refreshes at each denoising step ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ; Castillo et al., 2025 ) . Although existing CFG reuse strategies ( Lyu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) have proven effective for bidirectional full-attention video models, they are designed for a single denoising trajectory and assume global temporal consistency across the entire sequence. In AR video generation, however, each chunk follows its own denoising trajectory, and together these trajectories form a sequential path. This key difference makes independent per-chunk scheduling suboptimal, where reuse errors accumulate along the global AR path, and a decision that appears reasonable for one chunk can lead to significant cumulative error over the full path. Therefore, a globally calibrated reuse schedule covering the entire AR trajectory is essential. Motivated by this observation, we propose autoregressive trajectory-aware guidance scheduling (ATGS), which formulates CFG reuse scheduling as a path-planning problem over the sequential AR denoising path. As shown in the purple lines in Fig. 3 , CFG residual error is generally small across most steps but exhibits pronounced spikes at a few critical positions. This empirical pattern suggests that residuals can be safely reused within locally smooth intervals, while refreshes must be placed where residual changes are substantial. Consider two denoising steps i < t i<t , where the CFG residual is refreshed at step i i and reused at a later step t t . sents.en: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) introduces significant computational cost from repeated residual refreshes at each denoising step ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ; Castillo et al., 2025 ) .

sents.en: Although existing CFG reuse strategies ( Lyu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) have proven effective for bidirectional full-attention video models, they are designed for a single denoising trajectory and assume global temporal consistency across the entire sequence.
sents.zh: 尽管现有的 CFG 重用策略（Lyu 等，2025；Lee 等，2026）已被证明对双向全注意力视频模型有效，但这些策略是为单一去噪轨迹设计的，并假设整个序列具有全局时间一致性。

sents.en: In AR video generation, however, each chunk follows its own denoising trajectory, and together these trajectories form a sequential path.
sents.zh: 然而，在自回归（AR）视频生成中，每个片段都遵循其自身的去噪轨迹，而这些轨迹共同构成了一条序列路径。

sents.en: This key difference makes independent per-chunk scheduling suboptimal, where reuse errors accumulate along the global AR path, and a decision that appears reasonable for one chunk can lead to significant cumulative error over the full path.
sents.zh: 这一关键差异使得按片段独立安排重用策略并非最优：重用误差会沿着全局自回归路径不断累积，而一个对单个片段看似合理的决策，却可能在整个路径上引发严重的累积误差。

sents.en: Therefore, a globally calibrated reuse schedule covering the entire AR trajectory is essential.
sents.zh: 因此，覆盖整个自回归轨迹的全局校准重用调度方案至关重要。

sents.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose autoregressive trajectory-aware guidance scheduling (ATGS), which formulates CFG reuse scheduling as a path-planning problem over the sequential AR denoising path.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the efficacy of the proposed method, we select two representative autoregressive video generation backbones: SkyReels-V2-1.3B-540P and FramePack-F1 ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . SkyReels-V2 adopts a hierarchical autoregressive denoising pipeline: each video section is partitioned into chunks, and earlier chunks are denoised for a predefined number of steps before subsequent chunks enter the denoising process. This execution pattern produces non-uniform denoising levels across chunks at the same sampling iteration. FramePack-F1 follows a forward-only next-frame-section prediction pipeline. It packs previous frame contexts into a fixed context budget and generates later frame sections sequentially. In our experiments, FramePack-F1 uses 25 denoising steps per generated section, 145 generated frames, and 608 × 640 608\times 640 resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估所提方法的有效性，我们选择了两种具有代表性的自回归视频生成主干模型：SkyReels-V2-1.3B-540P 和 FramePack-F1（Chen 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2026）。 SkyReels-V2 采用了一种分层自回归去噪流程：每个视频片段被划分为多个区块，在后续区块进入去噪过程之前，先对前面的区块进行预定义步数的去噪处理。 这种执行模式会导致在同一采样迭代中，不同区块的去噪程度不统一。 FramePack-F1 遵循一种仅向前预测下一帧片段的流程。 它将先前帧的上下文信息压缩到固定的上下文预算中，并依次生成后续帧片段。 在我们的实验中，FramePack-F1 每个生成的片段使用 25 步去噪，生成 145 帧，分辨率为 608 × 640。

paragraphs.en: Additional Baseline Comparison. To determine if the efficiency-quality behavior of TRAC holds across a broader range of acceleration mechanisms, we further evaluate it against FreqForcing, FasterCache, and MeanCache on SkyReels-V2. These selected baselines cover various complementary training-free strategies, such as spectral correction, cache reuse, and JVP-based schedule selection. Since full evaluation of every auxiliary baseline is computationally expensive, we randomly sample 94 prompts from the VBench prompt set and evaluate all methods under matched prompts, seeds, resolutions, and video lengths. Table 3 presents the comparison under a matched evaluation setting. TRAC significantly outperforms the other methods in efficiency, achieving a 6.03 × 6.03\times speedup with a latency of only 266.8s. Although FreqForcing obtains slightly higher VBench aggregates (e.g., a Total score of 83.29 vs. TRAC’s 82.78), it requires a substantial 583.4s to complete. paragraphs.en: First, while TRAC is effective on two widely used autoregressive backbones and achieves the best trade-off between performance and speed, its generalization to emerging AR video models remains an open question. paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present trajectory-aware reuse and adaptive correction (TRAC), a training-free framework for efficient autoregressive (AR) video generation. Existing acceleration methods mainly target single-trajectory generation with bidirectional attention. AR video generation, by contrast, sequentially couples chunk-level denoising trajectories. Consequently, approximation errors accumulate and propagate through the generation process. TRAC addresses this challenge with three components, including robust cumulative scheduling (RCS), autoregressive trajectory-aware guidance scheduling (ATGS), and spectral structure correction (SSC). RCS selects cache reuse schedules by cumulative rollout error and cross-chunk/prompt variation. ATGS coordinates CFG refreshes along the global AR trajectory. SSC restores low-frequency structure of the first chunk to correct long-term structural loss. Experiments on SkyReels-V2 and FramePack-F1 show that, compared with existing methods, TRAC achieves both the highest inference efficiency and the best generation quality for AR video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了轨迹感知复用与自适应校正（TRAC），这是一种无需训练的框架，可用于高效的自回归（AR）视频生成。 现有的加速方法主要针对使用双向注意力的单轨迹生成。 相比之下，AR 视频生成是依次耦合各片段级别的去噪轨迹的。 因此，近似误差会在生成过程中不断累积并传播。 TRAC 通过三个组件应对这一挑战，包括稳健的累积调度（RCS）、自回归轨迹感知引导调度（ATGS）和光谱结构校正（SSC）。 RCS 根据累积展开误差以及片段间/提示间的差异来选择缓存复用调度方案。 ATGS 沿着全局 AR 轨迹协调配置分数（CFG）的更新。 SSC 通过恢复首个片段的低频结构来校正长期结构损失。 在 SkyReels-V2 和 FramePack-F1 上的实验表明，与现有方法相比，TRAC 在 AR 视频生成中同时实现了最高的推理效率和最佳的生成质量。
